mapper.select: SELECT id, producer_id, name, body, price, stock, category_id, origin_area, image, recommendation_score, create_at, update_at FROM products ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT p.*, pr.name AS producer_name FROM products p JOIN producers pr ON p.producer_id = pr.id JOIN product_seasons ps ON p.id = ps.product_id JOIN seasons s ON ps.season_id = s.id WHERE ( s.start_month <= s.end_month AND #{month} BETWEEN s.start_month AND s.end_month ) OR ( s.start_month > s.end_month AND ( #{month} >= s.start_month OR #{month} <= s.end_month ) ) ORDER BY p.recommendation_score DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM products p WHERE p.id IN (
SELECT oi3.product_id FROM orders my_order
JOIN order_items my_item ON my_order.id = my_item.order_id
JOIN order_items other_same_item ON my_item.product_id = other_same_item.product_id
JOIN orders other_order ON other_same_item.order_id = other_order.id
JOIN order_items oi3 ON other_order.id = oi3.order_id
WHERE my_order.user_id = #{userId} AND other_order.user_id <> #{userId} AND oi3.product_id NOT IN ( SELECT oi.product_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} )
GROUP BY oi3.product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC )
SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price <= #{maxPrice} ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, producer_id, name, body, price, stock, category_id, origin_area, image, recommendation_score, create_at, update_at FROM products WHERE producer_id = #{producerId} ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.* FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.address <> o.shipping_address GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.* FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.address <> o.shipping_address GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) DESC OFFSET 3

SELECT * FROM products WHERE 1 = 1
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND category_id IN
#{category}
AND origin_area IN
#{region}
ORDER BY id DESC
